explanation: Q1 selects drinkers who never have a beer they don't like served at any bar they frequent. Q2 selects drinkers whose every liked beer is served at at least one bar they frequent. These are different conditions.
counterexample_dsp: Alice frequents bar B1 which serves beer X (liked) and Y (not liked). Q1 excludes Alice because Y is served at B1 but not liked. Q2 includes Alice because her liked beer X is served at B1.
